Voxel-based Radiance Fields replace the multi-layer perceptron (MLP) of standard NeRF with explicit voxel grids to store volume density and spherical harmonic (SH) coefficients, enabling real-time volume rendering by eliminating heavy feed-forward neural computations [S1].

The source explicitly states that voxel-based radiance fields replace the MLP network with voxel grids ($G_σ$ and $G_{sh}$) to output volume density and spherical harmonic coefficients. The operation $S(d)^T G_{sh}(X_k)$ is a dot product (matrix multiplication of a row vector and a column vector). Therefore, the evidence fully supports the claim.
